What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance

Remedies need the scheme team’s decision. No specific next car or greater priority is guaranteed.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.

Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.

Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
Assumptions, seeds and provenance
Assumptions used
Setting	Key	Value	Unit	Status	Basis
How ties between employees are settled	allocation.tieBreak.rule	renewalDueThenFitThenSeededLottery	enum	Assumed	Assumed fairness: earlier renewal due, then higher eligible fit, then seeded tie-break. Not employee iteration/mail speed or verified BMW policy.
Highest slider setting in a brief	brief.slider.maximum	100	integer slider units	Assumed	Assumed `brief.slider.scale`; dimensions declare categorical alternatives where required.
Lowest calculated fit counted as acceptable	comparison.acceptableFitThreshold	70	calculated fit, 0-100	Assumed	Plausible boundary for an acceptable car, revisable. A missing fit never passes. Calculated fit is not observed satisfaction.
How the buddy route is modelled	comparison.buddyRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"generated-buddyParticipation","consent":"search-and-hold-given-through-brief-service-with-stated-brief","allocation":"at-each-release-through-allocation-service","orderingWindow":"participant-pauses-when-manual-ordering-closes","response":"offer-creation-plus-generated-responseSeconds","offerExpiry":"buddy-hold-deadline","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","declineReason":"registered-reason-for-largest-importance-weighted-shortfall","declineReasonFallback":"size","afterDeclineOrExpiry":"no-trigger-until-next-release-or-brief-change","nonParticipants":"comparison.manualRoute.v1"}	versioned buddy behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of preference-led buddy offers: consenting participants get offers at each release, answer at their generated response time or let the offer lapse at the hold deadline, accept only a car that passes their underlying needs, and decline naming the attribute where it falls shortest. The fallback reason applies when that attribute has no registered reason; size is the most general of the four. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
How today's release route is modelled	comparison.manualRoute.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"participation":"every-employee-in-the-current-route; buddy non-participants reuse it","accessEvent":"once-per-release-at-generated-accessSeconds-until-taken-or-renewal","accessTies":"employeeId-ascending","eventOrder":["release","expiry","access","claim","decision"],"candidateGate":"stated-brief-eligible-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","candidateOrder":"stated-fit-descending-then-orderUuid","listingToClaimSeconds":30,"decisionSeconds":60,"conflict":"refresh-listing-and-claim-next-candidate","acceptance":"underlying-gates-and-fit-at-or-above-threshold","acceptedHold":"order-review-then-allocate","unacceptableHold":"expire-without-taking","abandonedCar":"not-claimed-again-by-that-employee","expiryReentry":"next-modelled-access-event","renewalDeadline":"inclusive","responseSeconds":"not-used; the manual decision happens in the portal session"}	versioned manual behaviour	Assumed	Plausible model of today's first-come-first-served release: employees check the portal after each release at their modelled access time, take 30 s to claim from the listing and decide within the 120 s cart hold. Revisable; not observed BMW behaviour.
Rule for calling a difference clear	comparison.noClearDifferenceRule	{"schemaVersion":1,"rule":"route-seed-ranges-overlap","overlapInclusive":true,"minimumSeeds":3,"betterWhen":{"acceptableCoverage":"higher","carsNeverAllocated":"lower","heldNotTakenCarDays":"lower","declinedOffers":"lower","expiredOffers":"lower","failedClaims":"lower","retries":"lower","meanAcceptedFit":"higher","accessGroupCoverage":"higher"}}	versioned rule for labelling a route difference	Assumed	Two routes show no clear difference for a measure when their lowest-to-highest seed ranges overlap, with at least three seeds; fewer seeds are labelled insufficient. A rule of thumb for a small seed set, revisable; not a statistical test.
How long the buddy route holds a car	hold.buddy.durationSeconds	7200	seconds	Assumed	Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in the brief (Q15).
How long a car stays in a cart	hold.cart.durationSeconds	120	seconds	Assumed	Assumed exact value; target has about 2 minutes (Q15, round-1 findings).
How long a car is held while the order is reviewed	hold.cart.orderReview.durationSeconds	600	seconds	Assumed	Assumed separate form-review phase, FUCQ-66/SAN-017; test in manual trials.
Reasons an employee can give for declining	offer.declineReasons.v1	{"schemaVersion":1,"reasons":[{"code":"body-style","label":"Body style","attribute":"body"},{"code":"size","label":"Size","attribute":"sizeClass"},{"code":"fuel","label":"Fuel type","attribute":"fuel"},{"code":"equipment","label":"Equipment","attribute":"equipment"}]}	reason-registry	Assumed	FUCQ-106 fixed typed decline list and HLD blueprint 06/07; plausible categories, not verified BMW policy.
When a declined car can be offered again	offer.declinedCar.exclusion	untilRelevantConfirmedBriefChange	enum	Assumed	Assumed employee policy per HLD; unchanged declined `orderUuid` excluded, expiry excluded from dislike history.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.

What this replay leaves out
People, cars and behaviour are modelled, not BMW records.
Vehicle and driver facts are assumed; not observed BMW configurations, insurance, licence or employee behaviour.
Underlying needs are modelled inputs, not an employee confirmation.
Equipment and ISOFIX facts are unknown; no factory-option or constructibility inference.
Live corpus realism/integration is separate acceptance evidence.
Acceptance is recorded as a local offer decision; the ordering handoff is not replayed.
After an offer expires the live service re-offers its car at once (FUCQ-227); this replay leaves it for the next release.
